english.title: Speeding - passenger motor vehicle and trailer exceeding 60 mph - motorway - manned equipment
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) drove a passenger vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), drawing a trailer on a motorway, namely **(..SPECIFY MOTORWAY AND LOCATION..), at a speed exceeding 60 miles per hour
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 86(1), and 89(1) of and item 3 in the table in part 1 of Schedule 6 to the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
drove a passenger vehicle
drawing a trailer
on a motorway
at a speed exceeding 60 mph

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) 'Passenger vehicle' means a vehicle constructed solely for the carriage of passengers and their effects.
(ii) See schedule 6 to the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984 re other classes of vehicle.
(iii) Statement of facts procedure applies - see end of
document for wording.
(iv) See offence wording: H878 - relating to unmanned automatic equipment (speed camera).
(v) See offence wording: H20440 - for motor caravan, car derived van or dual-purpose vehicle (DPV) towing trailer on motorway, relating to police operated equipment.
(vi) Fixed penalty ticket scheme may be applied

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three to six penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
